premise: Duckling is not sleepy when the sun goes down; Frog sings slow, Firefly drifts down glowing, and the pond rocks him to sleep.
inspiration: Wynken, Blynken and Nod (Eugene Field, public domain), turned: nobody sails away to the stars; the stars and a firefly come down to the pond instead.

en-US.title: Goodnight, Little Pond
en-US.text: {canvas:sunset 0.6 22s} The sun was going down over the pond, but {duckling:enter} Duckling came waddling up, not sleepy at all. {duckling:face happy} [excited] {duckling:go to pond by swim} One more splash! {duckling:hop x2} One more paddle! {frog:enter} Frog {frog:pulse} blinked at him from the water. [softly] Listen, she said. The pond is getting sleepy. {frog:face happy} {sfx:ribbit} Ribbit… ribbit… she sang, low and slow. {sfx:night-bed} {canvas:night 0.7 45s} The sky turned deep blue, and the moon came up. {canvas:fireflies 0.5 35s} Then {firefly:enter} Firefly came drifting down, her tail aglow. {duckling:face surprised} [whispers] Oooh. {firefly:live} She closed her eyes and glowed brighter… and brighter… like a little lantern. Then she dimmed, and blinked twice. {duckling:face sleeping} Duckling's eyes grew heavy. {duckling:live hold} He fluffed up his feathers and tucked his head under his wing. {duckling:float loop 0.3} The water rocked him, gently, gently, like a cradle. {frog:face sleeping} [softly] Goodnight, Frog. {firefly:face sleeping} Goodnight, Firefly. Goodnight, little pond.

es-ES.title: Buenas noches, charquita
es-ES.text: {canvas:sunset 0.6 22s} El sol se estaba poniendo sobre la charca, pero {duckling:enter} Patito llegó bamboleándose, sin nada de sueño. {duckling:face happy} [excited] {duckling:go to pond by swim} ¡Un chapuzón más! {duckling:hop x2} ¡Una vuelta más! {frog:enter} Rana {frog:pulse} lo miró desde el agua. [softly] Escucha, le dijo. La charca se está durmiendo. {frog:face happy} {sfx:ribbit} Cruac… cruac… cantó, bajito y despacio. {sfx:night-bed} {canvas:night 0.7 45s} El cielo se puso azul oscuro, y salió la luna. {canvas:fireflies 0.5 35s} Entonces {firefly:enter} Luciérnaga bajó flotando, con la colita encendida. {duckling:face surprised} [whispers] Oooh. {firefly:live} Cerró los ojos y brilló más… y más… como un farolillo. Luego se apagó un poco, y parpadeó dos veces. {duckling:face sleeping} A Patito se le cerraban los ojos. {duckling:live hold} Se ahuecó las plumas y metió la cabeza bajo el ala. {duckling:float loop 0.3} El agua lo mecía, despacito, despacito, como una cuna. {frog:face sleeping} [softly] Buenas noches, Rana. {firefly:face sleeping} Buenas noches, Luciérnaga. Buenas noches, charquita.

ribbit.prompt: a soft, slow, sleepy frog croak by a pond

night-bed.prompt: gentle night crickets and a still pond, very calm
